articles.summary: GET /v1/studies/:id/participants now returns a moderator object (user_id, name, email) for each participant, so API and MCP consumers can see who is running a session without a second lookup. The field is nullable and returns null when no moderator is assigned. The user_id matches the id returned by GET /v1/interviews/:id/moderators, so you can join the two endpoints directly.
